Just get the hot stone with wagyu and oxtail
Apr 2026 • Friends
Location: facing a big road 250m (Google Map said so) from Ben Thanh Market.

Store: Original store still there, but they've a larger seating area two shops to the left. Renovated with AC which was good for hot and barmy Vietnam days.

Staff: Funny to hear Aussie twang from the few server guys, probably sons of owner? They love joking around with tourists!

Food: Just go for the top - hot stone with wagyu and oxtail, with those freshly made and cut rice noodles topped with a variety of fresh herbs, surprisingly nourishing even for hot days. Thank goodness they do have strong AC. They do have other cuts and combinations of meat - might be tougher, though.

Time: Cooking, serving, customer turnaround time is really fast. Probably because everything's so tender and easy to slurp up. Even if the place if full e.g. during peak, you won't have to wait for long for a seat.

Price: Reasonable.

24 Hours. Twice in Two Days.
Mar 2026 • Couples
Phở Việt Nam is something special. Open around the clock, and for good reason — we went twice in two days and would have gone back a third time without hesitation.

The pho is made continuously, and you can watch them slice the chicken breast directly off the bone as they prepare your bowl. The result is the most tender chicken I have ever had in a bowl of pho — impossibly silky and fresh. My husband, a chicken pho first-timer, was completely won over. The second visit was every bit as good as the first — consistent, generous, and deeply satisfying.

If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, don't walk past this one. At any hour.
